text:
Anna T: Quick heads-up — launching a dynamic search + creative pulse for Summer Spark next week. Need routing for webinar signups and retarget window, plus pacing play. Thoughts?
Mike L: 👍 Proposal: 7-day retarget window, feed webinar signups to webhook -> inbound_webinar queue. cc @Raj P for AE/SDR split.
Raj P: We should do firmographic routing: enterprise IPs -> AE queue, others -> SDR. I can add GCLID+CRM mapping. Also exclude current trials.
Sophia C: Creative plan: A/B test 3 hero images x 2 CTAs. Headline variants: 'Cut inference costs by 3x' vs 'Ship LLM features faster'. Short descriptions focused on latency and cost.
Anna T: Budget pacing idea: start at 75% of daily cap for first 48h, then allow scaling to 110% if CPA < $45. Can we automate that?
Mike L: Yes — use campaign-pacing-script v2. Rule (draft):
```
if rolling_24h_CPA <= 45 AND rolling_24h_CTR >= 1.2 then scale_budget(multiplier=1.1)
else if rolling_24h_CPA > 60 then reduce_budget(multiplier=0.8)
```
Will add as an automated rule.
Raj P: Search setup: keep exact and phrase for top 40 query terms, broad match for long-tail with smart bidding. Use DKI for headline where relevant. Add negatives: 'download', 'torrent', 'free', 'cracked'.
Sophia C: Creative rotation cadence: rotate every 36h for first 5 days to surface winners, then move to weekly refresh. I'll prepare thumbnails sized for search and display.
Anna T: Routing details: webinar signups -> webhook to /webhooks/marketing/webinar_inbound. Within the webhook, include utm params + account signals. We need an exclusion list for trial users.
Mike L: UTM template (dropping to #marketing-assets):
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=summer_spark&utm_content={creative_id}&utm_term={keyword}&gclid={gclid}
Also adding webhook payload spec and sample.
Sophia C: I'll upload 6 ad copy variations and 3 hero images by EOD. Copy will include one experimental CTA: 'See a 2-minute demo' vs 'Get cost estimates'.
Raj P: Exclusions: customers_trial_v2 list; also exclude current customers by account_hash. I'll push those segments to the campaign manager before launch.
Anna T: Good. Can we ensure we capture lead source for routing (GCLID, click_time, match_threshold)? Need that in case CRM mapping lags.
Mike L: Added click_time & match_confidence to webhook. If match_confidence < 0.8, route to SDR for manual verification.
Sophia C: Quick check — creative guidelines: no logos in hero, 20% text rule for display, CTA button consistent.
Anna T: Schedule 15min sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to finalize budgets and approval. Growth needs to sign off on CPA targets.
Mike L: Meeting scheduled. @growth-bot pinged for approval reminder.
growth-bot: Reminder set — Growth review due tomorrow 10:30am PT.
Anna T: Thanks team — I'll drop the final brief and dashboard links in this thread once ready.
Mike L: One last ask: enable view-through attribution for retargeting (3-day window). Helps us see display influence on search conversions.
Raj P: Noted. Also will add negative keyword block for brand cannibalization: exclude 'redwood pricing' from generic campaigns.
Sophia C: :thumbsup: On it. Files + mockups shortly.
Anna T: Perfect. Launch checklist: creative upload, pacing rules live, webhook + UTM tested, exclusion lists applied, tracking dashboard green. If we hit all that, go-live window = 2026-06-01 08:00 UTC.
Mike L: Campaign scheduled in manager for that window.
Anna T: Closing thread for now — post any blockers in #marketing-ops. Thanks!
